title: TIME JUMP — 07:00 CAT: HCT at 08:30, Buzi Team Still Silent

fields.jumpLabel: Clock moves to 07:00 (one hour after STARTEX)
fields.narration: It is now 07:00 Central Africa Time on Friday 12 February 2027. Over the last hour the rain has eased to showers, but the Buzi River is still rising. The ARA-Centro river bulletin at 06:45 puts the Buzi River at 6.1 m at the Buzi gauge, above the 5.0 m alert level and rising about 0.2 m an hour. INGD's latest radio bulletin now calls Guara-Guara and Estaquinha in Buzi district 'isolated'. The roll call board still reads 61 of 64. There is still no contact with the Buzi WASH team. Their last radio check-in was at 19:40 last night, 11 hours and 20 minutes ago. Two of the three families have called back, and one family member is now at the office gate asking to see someone. The UN Humanitarian Coordinator has called the first Humanitarian Country Team meeting for 08:30, online and at the OCHA Beira office. The NGO platform's principal is stuck in Quelimane, so the platform has asked HRI's Country Director to attend as the alternate. The Emergency Coordinator is in the air and cannot be reached until he lands in Beira at about 11:45. At the Beira warehouse, Arlindo and two daily workers have begun a pallet-by-pallet recount. The cluster stock sheet still shows Wednesday's pre-cyclone figures under HRI's name. The office generator has about 30 hours of diesel left. You have 90 minutes before the HCT meeting. Update your status boards.
worldState: Time: 07:00 CAT, Friday 12 February 2027. Weather: showers, rain easing. The Buzi River is still rising.
INGD radio bulletin: Guara-Guara and Estaquinha (Buzi district) are classed as 'isolated'. The EN6 crossing at Dondo is still cut.

Roll call: 61 of 64 accounted for. Missing: the Buzi WASH team (WASH officer Celso, driver Abílio, community mobiliser Graça). They have not been heard from since 19:40 on Thursday 11 February, 11 h 20 min ago.
Two of the three families have called back. One family member is now waiting at the office compound gate.
First HCT meeting: 08:30 CAT, online and at the OCHA Beira office. The HRI Country Director has been asked to attend for the NGO platform as alternate because the principal is in Quelimane.
UNDSS: one UN helicopter is tasked to Buzi for assessment this morning, and two INGD boats leave the Beira fish market quay at about 09:00. Seats are not guaranteed.
Emergency Coordinator: in flight from Nairobi and unreachable until landing in Beira at about 11:45.
Beira warehouse: the pallet-by-pallet recount has started (storekeeper plus two daily workers). There are no confirmed counts yet. The roof over rows C–E is still open to the rain.
Cluster stock sheet: still shows HRI's Wednesday balance of 3,000 shelter kits, 2,800 jerrycans, 4,000 hygiene kits and 12 portable water treatment units.
Office power: generator only. About 30 hours of diesel remain, enough until about 13:00 on Saturday at the current load.
Communications: mobile data is intermittent. HF radio works to Beira and Dondo only.
fields.facilitatorNote: This card opens Phase 2, Numbers That Disagree. Prompt the CD to assign tasks out loud before 08:30: SFP on the Buzi search and the families, LOG on the recount and Dondo, IMO on the numbers. Ask for the activation time and whether the Regional Director and the HQ CMT chair were notified within 2 hours of it. Watch whether anyone notices that the cluster stock sheet now overstates what HRI can offer at the HCT.

The CD should give clear task owners (SFP on the Buzi search, LOG on the recount, IMO on the numbers) and confirm that the Regional Director and the HQ CMT chair were notified within 2 hours of activation (Plan section 3).
